newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Gandel plans A$154 mln rights issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Gandel plans A$154 mln rights issue.

text.p: Gandel Retail Trust said on Wednesday it planned to raise A$154 million through a two-for-nine rights issue.
Gandel said it planned to issue about 160.5 million new units at 96 cents each, with the issue price payable in two instalments.
The proceeds of the issue would be used to develop and expand the trust's existing portfolio of shopping centres, and to buy other shopping centres.
In the short-term, the intitial proceeds would be used to reduce debt, it said.
The largest unitholder in the trust, the Gandel Group and its associated entitities, intended to accept its entitlements to about 54 million new units, Gandel Management Ltd said.
The balance of the issue, 160.5 milion units, was underwritten by J.B. Were & Son and ABN Amro Australia Hoare Govett Ltd.
